rows.ARS:
White, near white or white blend Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: WEKcryland
Exhibition name: Moonstone ™ (Hybrid Tea, Carruth 1998)
rows.Origin:
Bred by Tom Carruth (United States, before 1998).
Introduced in United States by Weeks Wholesale Rose Grower, Inc. in 2000 as 'Cadillac DeVille'.
rows.Bloom: White, pink edges. Flowers ivory white with a fine, delicate pink edging. Mild, spice, tea fragrance. 34 to 42 petals. Average diameter 4.75". Large, double (17-25 petals), borne mostly solitary, exhibition, high-centered to flat bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Medium. Large, matte, medium green foliage.

Height: 4' to 6' (120 to 185cm). Width: 31" to 39" (80 to 100cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 7b and warmer. Can be used for beds and borders, cut flower or garden. Prefers dry climates. Disease susceptibility: very disease resistant. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that. Requires spring freeze protection (see glossary - Spring freeze protection) . Can be grown in the ground or in a container (container requires winter protection).
